AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    IMPORT common 1.0
    IMPORT dk.ingatellent.SceneAssistant 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#toolbar > GridLayout
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater[.model=`toolbarProvider.editingTools`]
        INSERT {

ToolbarTool {
    id: aiTestOptions
    toolbar: root
    type: ToolbarTool.Type.FoldoutButton

    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
    enabled: true
    visible: root.expanded
    onPressed: root._select(aiTestOptions)

    function drawAiTest() {
        console.log("AI-SPIKE layerCount(before):", sceneController.layerCount,
                    "currentLayer(before):", sceneController.currentLayer);

        if (!SceneAssistant.ensureVtable(sceneController)) {
            console.log("AI-SPIKE FATAL: ensureVtable failed");
            return;
        }

        // settled reads BEFORE any mutation; name/switch by explicit index only.
        var userLayer = sceneController.currentLayer;
        var aiLayer = sceneController.layerCount;   // index the new layer will get

        sceneController.addLayer();
        sceneController.setLayerName(aiLayer, "AI-TEST");
        sceneController.setCurrentLayer(aiLayer);

        // bottom region of the page, away from handwriting
        var l = SceneAssistant.createLine(Qt.point(200, 1900), Qt.point(600, 1900));
        sceneController.addDrawingLine(l);
        sceneView.tileManager.renderLineToTiles(l);
        sceneView.tileManager.reload();
        console.log("AI-SPIKE line drawn; aiLayer =", aiLayer);

        // hand control straight back to the user's own layer
        sceneController.setCurrentLayer(userLayer);
        console.log("AI-SPIKE returned to user layer", userLayer);
        root._select(aiTestOptions);
    }

    foldoutContent: ColumnLayout {
        spacing: 0

        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
            label: "Draw AI Test"
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            onClicked: aiTestOptions.drawAiTest()
        }

        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
            label: "Dump Keys"
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            onClicked: {
                console.log("AI-SPIKE keys:", Object.keys(sceneController).join(","));
                console.log("AI-SPIKE view keys:", Object.keys(sceneView).join(","));
                console.log("AI-SPIKE currentLayer:", sceneController.currentLayer);
            }
        }

        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
            label: "Dump Scene"
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/grid"
            antialiasing: root.antialiasing
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            onClicked: sceneController.dumpScene()
        }
    }
}

        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
